traversal: region CA1 then PFC; repetition0..499; declared animal order KL8,ER1,JS34,JS14,JS17,JS21,JS15,ZT2; session1..8
main_draw_order: choice(500,300,replace=False) training positions; sorted complement is test
state_capture: Snapshot the MT19937 state immediately before randn(4,500), before any readout fit. The same frozen state and teacher/training manifest must be used for reference and candidate; no candidate-dependent redraw.

state_object.keys: 624 unsigned32-bit integers in get_state order, serialized as ordinary JSON integer array
state_object.has_gauss: get_state cached-Gaussian flag as JSON integer0or1
state_object.cached_gaussian: get_state cached Gaussian as finite JSON float; signed zero is preserved by json.dumps

state_sha256: lowercase64-character hexadecimal SHA256 of exact state serialization
teacher_index: zero-based original column index0..499, before balance filtering; encoded as ordinary base10 integer without leading zeros
primary_svc: Serial sklearn.svm.LinearSVC(dual='auto',max_iter=10000,random_state=per_teacher_seed); all remaining constructor defaults recorded by runtime version
literal_source_svc: Serial callable sklearn.svm.LinearSVC(dual='auto',max_iter=10000,random_state=None); global runtime RNG is unbound. This preserves the literal None option but does not reconstruct source n_jobs=-1 worker RNG or historical scheduling.
main_rng_isolation: Primary SVC seed derivation never calls choice,randint,randn or another RNG draw; per-task estimators receive their own integer seeds and must not consume the main region stream.
balance_rule: Keep original teacher columns with abs(mean(sign(z @ teachers),axis=0))<0.25 over all500 source observations; require strictly more than100 columns. Full-row task filtering sees eventual test rows and remains source exposure.
paired_comparison: Freeze row IDs, unit IDs, latent/teacher identities, retained original teacher indices, train/test IDs, stateSHA and per-teacher seeds before any candidate-dependent operation. Reuse this exact manifest across reference and candidate; a method may not request fresh draws after viewing outcomes.
recording: Record full pre/post RNG state, pre-teacher stateSHA, teacher-array dtype/shape/hash, retained teacher indices, native row/unit IDs, training/test IDs, every per-teacher seed, warnings and NumPy/SciPy/scikit-learn versions.
glm_pr_rng: Caller supplies an explicit independently recorded RandomState. For each of500 repetitions draw19 raw units then independently draw19 fitted units; do not silently couple those subsets.
source_discrepancies: Declared animal order is current; source geometry used unsorted glob order.
Source figure PR RNG is unseeded; caller-frozen PR stream is a current realization.
